ARM_CFG_GROUPS.BEGIN:
# ARM (Automatic Ripping Machine) config file

#################
## ARM Options ##
#################
ARM_CFG_GROUPS.EMBY_ADDITIONAL: # Parameters to enable automatic library scan in Emby.  This will trigger only if MainFeature is true above.

ARM_NAME:
# A friendly name for this machine. Useful if you are running multiple instances.
# Used in notification titles.
ARM_CHILDREN:
# Comma delimited list of child ARM servers to display on the Home Page
# Should be full protocol, path, and port: http://192.168.0.100:8080/
PREVENT_99:
# Workaround for Track 99
# A DRM scheme used on some DVDs which creates fake titles which confuses Handbrake.
# When set to "false" affected DVDs will be passed to MakeMKV for ripping, but this can crash or hang
# Setting this to true will eject the disc and log only to the system logging
ARM_CHECK_UDF: # Distinguish UDF video discs from UDF data discs.  Requires mounting disc so adds a few seconds to the identify script.
GET_VIDEO_TITLE:
# When enabled if the disc is a DVD use dvdid to calculate a crc64 and query Windows Media Meta Services for the Movie Title.
# For BluRays attempts to extract the title from an XML file on the disc
ARM_API_KEY:
# ARM dvd crc64 api key
# This is only needed if you would like to send movies to the database
DISABLE_LOGIN:
# Do you want to be forced to login to view/edit jobs
# True will leave all of the pages open to be editable/viewable by anyone
# False will require you to login to view/edit jobs or settings from the ui
# ARMui will need to be restared for this to update
SKIP_TRANSCODE:
# Skip transcoding if you want the original MakeMKV files as your final output
# This will produce the highest quality videos (and use the most storage)
# Note: RIPMETHOD must be set to "mkv" for this feature to work
# Note: The largest file will be considered to be the "main feature" but there are cases when this is not true
# to avoid losing a desired track, use this feature with an EXTRAS_SUB value that is not "None"
VIDEOTYPE:
# Video type identification.  Options are "auto", "series", "movie".
# If "auto" then ARM will get the video type when querying the movie webservice.  This is default.
# If the disc is not clearly a movie or series, or if ARM is having difficulty getting the right video type
# you can override the automatic identification with "series" or "movie"
MINLENGTH: # Minimum length of track for ARM rip (in seconds)
MAXLENGTH:
# Maximum length of track for ARM rip (in seconds)
# Use "99999" to indicate no maximum length
MANUAL_WAIT_TIME: # Wait time for manual identification (in seconds)
DATE_FORMAT:
# Allows you to format the date/time to your own liking
# This will be used throughout ARM and ARMui
ALLOW_DUPLICATES:
## Do you want to allow Rips of the same disk multiple times
## With this set as false the task will exit if it recognises the same movie being ripped
## recommended to set to true for series
MAX_CONCURRENT_TRANSCODES:
# Number of Transcodes that runs at the same time.
# Certain Video cards are limited to how many encodes they can run at the same time.
# Also useful for diminishing returns on CPU based encodes.
# Set to 0 to disable
MAX_CONCURRENT_MAKEMKVINFO:
# Number of MakeMKV info calls that are allowed to run.
#This can be set to 1 if makemkvcon info calls lead to crashes on backup or mkv calls.
# Set to 0 to disable
DATA_RIP_PARAMETERS: # Additional parameters for dd. e.g. "conv=noerror,sync" for ignoring read errors
METADATA_PROVIDER:
# This selects the metadata provider, Each provider has their own ups and downs
# But a general rule would be 
# OMDB for movies and shows 
# TMDB for movies only
# You will still need to provide an api key for the provider you have selected
GET_AUDIO_TITLE:
# Set to one of "none", "musicbrainz", "freecddb"
# if "musicbrainz" is used the disc information are asked from musicbrainz.org
# if "none" is used no label is identified
RIP_POSTER:
# Rip DVD Posters from JACKET_P folder
# Requires FFmpeg
AUTO_EJECT:
# Auto-ejects disks
# Auto-ejects disks when complete etc
# Set to false to disable auto-ejection
ABCDE_CONFIG_FILE: # Location of your ABCDE config file
RAW_PATH:
# Path to raw MakeMKV directory
# Destination for MakeMKV and source for HandBrake
TRANSCODE_PATH:
# Intermediary directory for transcoding files
# Destination for HandBrake
COMPLETED_PATH:
# Final directory of transcoded files
# Ripped and transcoded files end up here
EXTRAS_SUB:
# Movie subdirectory name for "extras"
# Valid names are dependent on your media server
# For Emby see https://github.com/MediaBrowser/Wiki/wiki/Movie%20naming#user-content-movie-extras
# For Plex see https://support.plex.tv/hc/en-us/articles/200220677
LOGPATH:
# Path to directory to hold log files
# Make sure to include trailing /
LOGLEVEL:
# Log level.  DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, CRITICAL
# The default is INFO
# If you are experiencing difficulties set this to DEBUG
LOGLIFE:
# How long to let log files live before deleting (in days)
# Set to 0 to disable
WEBSERVER_IP:
# IP address of web server (this machine)
# Use x.x.x.x to autodetect the IP address to use
UI_BASE_URL:
# Base URL to use for notifications and display purposes
#Be sure to include protocol and port if needed (e.g. http://example.com:8091 or https://example.com)
SET_MEDIA_PERMISSIONS:
# Enabling this setting will allow you to adjust the default file permissions of the outputted files
# The default value is set to 777 for read/write/execute for all users, but can be changed below using the "CHMOD_VALUE" setting
# This setting is helpful when storing the data locally on the system
SET_MEDIA_OWNER: # Don't bother. This does not do anything yet
MAKEMKV_PERMA_KEY: # Storage for a purchased key the user may have paid for. Populating will prevent the beta key updater from running.
RIPMETHOD:
# Method of MakeMKV to use for Blu Ray discs.  Options are "mkv", "backup" or "backup_dvd".
# backup decrypts the dvd and then copies it to the hard drive.  This allows HandBrake to apply some of it's
# analytical abilities such as the main-feature identification.  This method seems to offer success on bluray 
# discs that fail in "mkv" mode. *** NOTE: MakeMKV only supports the backup or backup_dvd method on BluRay discs.
# backup_dvd forces arm to extract the dvd with MakeMKV prior to the Handbrake step
MKV_ARGS:
# MakeMKV Arguments
# MakeMKV Profile used for controlling Audio Track Selection.
# This is the default profile MakeMKV uses for Audio track selection. Updating this file or changing it is considered
# to be advanced usage of MakeMKV. But this will allow users to alternatively tell makemkv to select HD audio tracks and etc.
# MKV_ARGS: "--profile=/opt/arm/default.mmcp.xml"
# MKV_ARGS: "--debug=-stdout"  # this will enable more detailed logging
DELRAWFILES: # Remove any files created in the raw and transcode paths for the job after processing is complete
HB_PRESET_DVD:
# Handbrake preset profile for DVDs
# Execute "HandBrakeCLI -z" to see a list of all presets
HB_PRESET_BD:
# Handbrake preset profile for Blurays
# Execute "HandBrakeCLI -z" to see a list of all presets
DEST_EXT: # Extension of the final video file
HANDBRAKE_CLI: # Handbrake binary to call.  These should be the same unless you are doing remote processing.
HANDBRAKE_LOCAL: # Handbrake binary to call.  These should be the same unless you are doing remote processing.
FFMPEG_PRE_FILE_ARGS: # CLI Arguments for FFMPEG that go before the -i input_file. Can be found by doing ffmpeg -h.
FFMPEG_POST_FILE_ARGS: # CLI Arguments for FFMPEG that go after the -i input_file. Can be found by doing ffmpeg -h.
FFMPEG_CLI: # FFMPEG binary to call. These should be the same unless you are doing remote processing.
FFMPEG_LOCAL: # FFMPEG binary to call. These should be the same unless you are doing remote processing.
USE_FFMPEG: # Use FFMPEG for transcoding instead of handbreak. Set to true to enable.
MAINFEATURE:
# Have HandBrake transcode the main feature only.  BluRay discs must have RIPMETHOD="backup" for this to work.
# If MAINFEATURE is true, blurays will be backed up to the HD and then HandBrake will go to work on the backed up
# files.  
# This will require libdvdcss2 be installed.
# NOTE: For the most part, HandBrake correctly identifies the main feature on movie DVD's, although it is not perfect. 
# However, it does not handle tv shows well at all.  This setting is only used when the video is identified as a movie.
HB_ARGS_BD: # Additional Handbrake arguments for Bluray Discs.
EMBY_REFRESH: # Scan emby library after successful placement of mainfeature (see above)
EMBY_SERVER:
# Server parameters
# Server can be ip address or domain name
EMBY_CLIENT: # Emby authentication fluff parameters.  These can be anything.
EMBY_USERNAME: # Emby authentication parameters.  These are parameters that must be set to a current user in Emby.
EMBY_USERID:
# EMBY_USERID is the user ID associated with the username above.  You can find this by going to the following address on your emby server
# <server>:<port>/Users/Public and getting the ID value for the username above.
EMBY_PASSWORD:
# This is the SHA1 encrypted password for the username above.  You can generate the SHA1 hash of your password by executing the following at
# the command line: 
# echo -n your-password | sha1sum | awk '{print $1}'
# or using an online generator like the one located at http://www.sha1-online.com/
EMBY_API_KEY:
# Emby API key.  This can be found (generated) by going to Advanced/Security in the 
# Emby dashboard
NOTIFY_JOBID: # Add Job ID to Notification Title
PB_KEY:
# Pushbullet API Key
# Leave empty to disable Pushbullet notifications
IFTTT_KEY:
# IFTTT API KEY
# Leave empty to disable IFTTT notifications
PO_USER_KEY:
# Pushover API User and Application Key
# Leave User key empty to disable Pushover notifications
OMDB_API_KEY:
# OMDB_API_KEY
# omdbapi.com API Key
# See README-OMDBAPI for background and info
# This is the API key for omdbapi.com queries.
# More info at https://omdbapi.com/
TMDB_API_KEY:
# TMDB_API_KEY
# https://www.themoviedb.org/ API Key
# See README-OMDBAPI for background and info
# This is the API key for https://www.themoviedb.org/ queries.
# More info at https://www.themoviedb.org/documentation/api
JSON_URL:
# JSON_URL
# Url to send Notifications to in JSON format
APPRISE:
# File location of your apprise.yaml file. 
# Docker default is '/etc/arm/config/apprise.yaml'.
index_refresh:
How often to refresh the home page in milliseconds #
 (This updates jobs) #
 Default setting is '2000', updating the home page every 2 seconds.
use_icons:
Use icons, if false A.R.M will use text 
##ripping|transcoding|etc
save_remote_images:
Save job images locally ? 
# If True: A.R.M will copy remote images to a local directory and use the update the job to use the local version.
bootstrap_skin:
Bootstrap remote skin 
# You can find all versions available from 
#https://www.bootstrapcdn.com/bootswatch/
# You will need to refresh the page to see the updated bootstrap skin
language: What language do you want A.R.M to use ?
database_limit: limit the number of jobs to show on each page, over 175 will make things go funky!
notify_refresh: Set the Notification timeout value in milliseconds, values less than 1 second should be avoided.
NTFY_SERVER:
# NTFY_SERVER
# ntfy server.
# Address of your ntfy server, e.g. https://ntfy.example.com. Leave empty to turn phone notifications
# off.
NTFY_TOPIC:
# NTFY_TOPIC
# ntfy topic.
# Topic your phone is subscribed to.
NTFY_TOKEN:
# NTFY_TOKEN
# ntfy access token.
# Only needed if your ntfy server requires a login (tk_...).
NTFY_SEND_ALL:
# NTFY_SEND_ALL
# Send every ARM notification.
# Also send ARM's normal messages (disc found, rip complete, ...) to ntfy. When off, ntfy only gets
# things that need you, problems and the daily summary.
ARM_PHONE_URL:
# ARM_PHONE_URL
# ARM address for your phone.
# How your phone reaches this ARM, used for the buttons in notifications, e.g.
# http://192.168.0.121:8080. Empty uses UI_BASE_URL.
CONFIDENCE_ENABLED:
# CONFIDENCE_ENABLED
# Score identification confidence.
# Rate how sure ARM is about each disc's title (0-100) from the label, the TMDb runtime and earlier
# rips of the same disc.
CONFIDENCE_NOTIFY_BELOW:
# CONFIDENCE_NOTIFY_BELOW
# Ask me below.
# Below this score ARM sends a notification with Confirm / Pick another buttons and waits for you.
CONFIDENCE_SKIP_WAIT_ABOVE:
# CONFIDENCE_SKIP_WAIT_ABOVE
# Don't wait above.
# At or above this score ARM skips the manual-wait period and starts ripping right away. 0 = always
# wait as usual.
LOW_CONFIDENCE_WAIT_TIME:
# LOW_CONFIDENCE_WAIT_TIME
# Wait for low confidence (seconds).
# How long to wait for you when the score is low. After that ARM rips with its best guess. 0 = use
# MANUAL_WAIT_TIME.
RUNTIME_MATCHING:
# RUNTIME_MATCHING
# Use the runtime to identify.
# When the label is vague, search TMDb and pick the result whose runtime matches the main title.
ALREADY_RIPPED_ACTION:
# ALREADY_RIPPED_ACTION
# Disc already ripped.
# What to do when the same disc was ripped before and its files still exist: rip = rip again, notify =
# rip and tell you, skip = eject without ripping.
# One of: rip, notify, skip
MIN_FREE_GB_DVD:
# MIN_FREE_GB_DVD
# Free space needed for a DVD (GB).
# Free space ARM needs in the raw, transcode and completed folders before ripping a DVD.
MIN_FREE_GB_BLURAY:
# MIN_FREE_GB_BLURAY
# Free space needed for a Blu-ray (GB).
# Same for Blu-rays.
DISK_SPACE_ACTION:
# DISK_SPACE_ACTION
# When space is short.
# wait = notify and check every 5 minutes for up to 2 hours, fail = stop the job, ignore = rip anyway.
# One of: wait, fail, ignore
TITLE_ANALYSIS:
# TITLE_ANALYSIS
# Analyse the disc's titles.
# Work out which titles are the main feature, other cuts, language versions, duplicates, extras or TV
# episodes, rip only what's needed and name the files accordingly.
PREFERRED_LANGUAGE:
# PREFERRED_LANGUAGE
# Preferred language.
# ISO 639-2 code (eng, fra, deu, spa, ...). Picks the main version when a disc has the movie in
# several languages.
KEEP_ALTERNATE_CUTS:
# KEEP_ALTERNATE_CUTS
# Keep other cuts.
# Also rip theatrical / extended / director's cuts. They're saved next to the movie as versions
# Jellyfin can switch between.
KEEP_OTHER_LANGUAGE_VERSIONS:
# KEEP_OTHER_LANGUAGE_VERSIONS
# Keep other language versions.
# Also rip the movie's versions in other languages. When ARM can't tell which version is yours, it
# keeps them all and asks.
SKIP_DUPLICATE_TITLES:
# SKIP_DUPLICATE_TITLES
# Skip duplicate titles.
# Don't rip titles that are exact copies of another title (common on protected discs) or "play all"
# titles on TV discs.
ORGANIZE_EXTRAS:
# ORGANIZE_EXTRAS
# Name extras.
# Put extras in the extras folder with readable names instead of B1_t03.mkv.
TV_EPISODE_MATCHING:
# TV_EPISODE_MATCHING
# Match TV episodes.
# Match titles to episodes using TMDb episode runtimes and name them Show S01E03.mkv.
VERIFY_OUTPUT:
# VERIFY_OUTPUT
# Check finished files.
# Compare each finished file's length with the disc title before deleting the raw rip. If one is
# short, the raw files are kept and you're told.
VERIFY_TOLERANCE_SECONDS:
# VERIFY_TOLERANCE_SECONDS
# Allowed difference (seconds).
# How much shorter a file may be than its title before it counts as cut off.
READ_ERROR_RETRIES:
# READ_ERROR_RETRIES
# Retries after a MakeMKV failure.
# Retry the rip this many times. If it still fails you get "clean the disc or try the other drive".
STUCK_JOB_MINUTES:
# STUCK_JOB_MINUTES
# Stuck after (minutes).
# A rip or transcode with no progress for this long counts as stuck. 0 = off.
STUCK_JOB_ACTION:
# STUCK_JOB_ACTION
# When a job is stuck.
# notify = tell you, abandon = stop it cleanly, eject and tell you.
# One of: notify, abandon
TRIM_TRACKS:
# TRIM_TRACKS
# Keep only my languages.
# Only keep audio and subtitle tracks in the languages below (plus commentary and forced subtitles)
# when transcoding with HandBrake.
KEEP_AUDIO_LANGUAGES:
# KEEP_AUDIO_LANGUAGES
# Audio languages.
# Comma-separated ISO 639-2 codes, e.g. eng,fra.
KEEP_SUBTITLE_LANGUAGES:
# KEEP_SUBTITLE_LANGUAGES
# Subtitle languages.
# Comma-separated ISO 639-2 codes.
JELLYFIN_URL:
# JELLYFIN_URL
# Jellyfin address.
# e.g. http://192.168.0.121:8096. Leave empty to turn this off.
JELLYFIN_API_KEY:
# JELLYFIN_API_KEY
# Jellyfin API key.
# Create one in Jellyfin: Dashboard > API Keys.
JELLYFIN_MEDIA_ROOT:
# JELLYFIN_MEDIA_ROOT
# Media folder in Jellyfin.
# Where Jellyfin sees your NAS media share.
JELLYFIN_FOLDER_MAP:
# JELLYFIN_FOLDER_MAP
# Folder names.
# ARM folder = folder under the media share, separated by semicolons.
JELLYFIN_VERIFY_MATCH:
# JELLYFIN_VERIFY_MATCH
# Check Jellyfin's match.
# After the scan, check Jellyfin matched the same movie or show ARM ripped.
DB_BACKUP_ENABLED:
# DB_BACKUP_ENABLED
# Back up the database daily.
DB_BACKUP_DIR:
# DB_BACKUP_DIR
# Backup folder.
# Empty = a backups folder next to the database.
CLEANUP_ENABLED:
# CLEANUP_ENABLED
# Clean up daily.
# Remove leftover raw and transcode folders that no job is using.
CLEANUP_FAILED_DUPLICATE_JOBS:
# CLEANUP_FAILED_DUPLICATE_JOBS
# Remove superseded failed jobs.
# Delete failed jobs from the database once the same disc has been ripped successfully.
DAILY_SUMMARY_ENABLED:
# DAILY_SUMMARY_ENABLED
# Daily summary.
# One notification a day: what got ripped, what's unidentified and what failed.
